subject: Mythology
title: Maya: The Cosmic Illusion
description: One-minute skill: Maya: The Cosmic Illusion.

hook.text: Hindu philosophy says the entire physical world is maya — a cosmic illusion hiding the true nature of reality.

buildup.text: What we see, touch, and experience feels real but is temporary. Only the soul and the divine are permanent.

discovery.text: Krishna showed his cosmic form to Arjuna, revealing that behind the illusion lay infinite, terrifying truth.

twist.text: Maya is not evil. It is the creative power of the divine, making the universe possible while hiding its source.

climax.text: Enlightenment means seeing through maya — recognizing that the self and the universe are one and the same.

punchline.text: Everything you see is a curtain. Wisdom is learning to look behind it.

quiz.question: What is maya in Hindu philosophy?
options: A goddess who controls human dreams
A cosmic illusion that hides the true nature of reality
The energy that powers the cycle of rebirth
